pages.transcription:
Friday, Sept 4th, 41

Dearest Mamma, Please stop worrying about us, we will
be alright and even if things do not always go for us
as we would like it and if we complain once in a while
don't take it too seriously. Those last weeks in USA with
all the indecision were difficult, but now that we are
here we are going to settle down again. We have already
found a house in Petropolis which suits our purpose
very well. It is small - bungalow style - has a large terrace with a beautiful
view over the mountains, you climb up to it from the street on a
number of steps, it has a small garden and is tolerably furnished.
We are satisfied to have found it, as it is not at all easy and
most houses are either dreadfully ugly or dreadfully expensive.
The servant question, which as I am told is also difficult, also
promises to be solved for us for the time being as the couple
who look after the house at present will probably remain
until I find what I need. Being without servants is in so far
very disagreeable here as in Petropolis the kitchen stoves are
exactly of the type of children's toy stoves and have to be looked
after all the time. We hope to be able to go up to Petropolis
next weekend and intend to come to Rio fairly frequently. It is
still very quiet in Pet. and the air reminds one even of a european
spring. - We shall cable you the address as soon as we definitely
go up there and I repeat it here 34 Rua GONCALVEZ DIAS
Petropolis, Brazil
but please note that it is only for cables. Letters please continue
to address to Editora GUANABARA, they will be forwarded
immediately from there by a professional messenger which is safer
than trust them to the change of the little railroad and delivery
in Petropolis. - We had a letter from Eva and Mrs. Sch. Both write
how beautiful presents she got from everyone and Mrs Sch wrote that
Eva was well and cheerful. It seems that they have already moved
to the new house and I hope that you and I soon get details
about the life there. - I must close now, first of all our Por-
tuguese teacher just arrived and secondly the mail for to-morrow's
clipper closes in a few minutes. - We have received
today your letter of Aug. 20th and Mama's of Aug 22nd,
not so bad really, just a fortnight.
Love to all, best wishes
for the solutions of the servant question in Bath,
Lotte
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Hotelpapier (Hotel Central, Rio de Janeiro). Tinte violett. Sehr gut lesbar.
